purpose: Dated gates the front office and the game builder use. Each date carries its source and whether it was knowable on the career date; a date marked projected is replaced by the actual only when its computation date is reached.

events.note: Team options, player options, qualifying offers and tenders are due.
events.source: Larry Coon, 1999 Salary Cap FAQ, Q34 (library/2003/league/cba_1999_salary_cap_faq_extract.txt)

events.note: Free agents may negotiate with any club and agree in principle; nothing may be signed.
events.source: ESPN, July 15, 2003: cap released on the eve of the expiration of a moratorium on free agent signings (https://www.espn.com/nba/news/2003/0715/1581132.html)
events.trades: no trade July 1-15 (inferred; see nba_1999_cba_rules.json trades.moratorium_trade_ban)

events.note: 2003-04 salary cap $43,840,000, mid-level exception $4,917,000, $1.5M exception, minimum team salary $32,880,000.
Moratorium over; contracts and offer sheets may be signed.
events.source: Basketball-Reference 2003-04 transactions: first free-agent signings dated July 16, 2003 (https://www.basketball-reference.com/leagues/NBA_2004_transactions.html)

events.note: Camps opened at the end of September; the exact 2003 date needs a period source before the clock uses it. Up to 20 players under contract.
Regular season begins; rosters cut to 15 (12 active, up to 3 on the injured list).
Ten-day contracts allowed from January 5 (modern rule, believed unchanged since 1999).

events.source: Basketball-Reference, trades dated February 19, 2004 (https://www.basketball-reference.com/teams/DET/2004_transactions.html); Slam Online

events.note: The 2003-04 tax line is computed after the season from league revenue; in July 2003 the union projected about $57,000,000. The actual, $54,556,722, applies only from this date.
events.source: ESPN, July 15, 2003 (projection); Wikipedia, Luxury tax (sports), NBA table (actual)

events.note: Miami's team option on Wade's fourth season must be exercised by October 31 after his second season.
events.source: Larry Coon, 1999 Salary Cap FAQ, Q38 (extract line: 'this option must be exercised by October 31 after the player's second season')
